name: Families Broken
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of broken families, highlighting the spiritual and relational challenges that come when allegiance to Christ causes division even among close relatives (Matthew 10:35; Luke 14:26). Yet, God draws near to those with broken hearts and contrite spirits, offering comfort and salvation (Psalms 34:18). The call to train children in the Lord's ways remains vital (Proverbs 22:6), and believers are urged to extend kindness and forgiveness within relationships, reflecting God's grace through Christ (Ephesians 4:32). Jesus' own earthly experience of homelessness (Matthew 8:20) underscores the cost of faithful discipleship amid familial hardship.
